title: verify_entry never called during peering ingestion — LogEntry signatures unenforced
description: group_log/verify.rs has a fully working verify_entry() that checks operator_signature, parent existence, and HLC monotonicity. But check_ingest() in transit/peering/ingestion.rs (the ingestion validation gate) never calls it. The run_pipeline() path also does not call verify_entry. Trigger: malicious peer sends IHAVE/TAKETHIS with a LogEntry whose operator_signature is zeroed, forged, or missing. Bad behavior: entry is accepted, stored, and propagated with no signature verification. The signature field is populated during local POST but ignored during peer ingest, making it non-binding. The security contract (operator controls what enters their group log) is not enforced for inbound articles.
